name: F-30 Open WebUI Trigger
_comment: Called by the Open WebUI 'n8n Trigger' pipe (helm/openwebui/functions/n8n_pipe.py). A prompt starting with '/<flow>' fans out to that flow's webhook via N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE; anything else returns a help string. responseMode=lastNode so the pipe reads the reply from {response}.

parameters.jsCode:
return [{ json: { response: 'No command recognised. Start your message with a slash command, e.g.

  /plan-release 1.4.0
  /kickoff my-project
  /develop 1.4.0
  /uat 1.4.0

One command maps to one F-* flow webhook.' } }];
